meta.name: sleek-design-mobile-apps
meta.description: Use when the user wants to design a mobile app, create screens, build UI, or interact with their Sleek projects. Covers high-level requests ("design an app that does X") and specific ones ("list my projects", "create a new project", "screenshot that screen").

copy.tagline: 设计移动应用界面，创建屏幕和交互原型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速设计移动应用界面并与Sleek项目交互
copy.tagline_en: Design mobile app interfaces, create screens and interactive prototypes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly design mobile app interfaces and interact with Sleek projects

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 Sleek API 创建和管理移动应用项目、发送设计需求、获取生成的屏幕代码和截图。
howto.when: 当用户要求设计移动应用、创建屏幕、构建 UI 或操作 Sleek 项目时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个健身追踪应用，包含首页和运动记录页。
say.note: Claude 会创建项目并发送设计请求给 Sleek。

say.text: 列出我所有的 Sleek 项目。
say.note: Claude 会调用 API 获取项目列表。

say.text: 给当前项目的主屏幕截图。
say.note: Claude 会请求渲染并返回截图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create and manage mobile app projects, send design requests, and retrieve generated screen code and screenshots via the Sleek API.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to design a mobile app, create screens, build UI, or interact with their Sleek projects.

say_en.text: Design a fitness tracking app with a home screen and activity log.
say_en.note: Claude creates a project and sends the design request to Sleek.
Claude calls the API to fetch the project list.

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of the main screen in the current project.
say_en.note: Claude requests a screenshot and returns it.
